decisions.reason: As a new-generation high-resolution printer at the core of our marking portfolio, it fits our strengths in robust industrial hardware and supports growth in customized coding solutions.
This numbering software directly strengthens our digital inline printing offer and supports customers’ needs for variable data, serialization and traceability.
An inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces broadens our application coverage in a core technology area and is well aligned with our one-stop industrial marking strategy.
The decoding app complements our installed base and reinforces our move toward end-to-end code readability, verification and digital service offerings.
Inline code verification is strategically important for compliance and traceability and deepens our value proposition beyond printing into quality assurance.
Print layout design software improves system usability and integration across our portfolio, making it a strong complement to our hardware and software ecosystem.
